verdict.rationale: Atlas includes a Delaware registered agent (docs-7), so service-of-process handling is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence describes immediate alerts when a lawsuit or legal notice is received. The filing reminders and onboarding emails users mention are adjacent features, not notification of service of process.

support.subject: As a founder, a lawsuit or other time-sensitive legal notice triggers an immediate notification rather than waiting on a mail batch
